# pip-cache

pip's download and wheel cache. pip downloads packages again when needed.

**Name:** pip cache · **Category:** Package caches · **Status:** stable · **Systems:** macOS, Linux, Windows

Upstream docs: <https://pip.pypa.io/en/stable/topics/caching/>

**Detected when** one of `pip`, `pip3` is on PATH or one of `{cache}` exists.

## Paths

Resolved in this order: the tool's own command, then the environment variable, then the system default.

- `{cache}`: `pip cache dir` → `$PIP_CACHE_DIR` → macOS `~/Library/Caches/pip` → Linux `$XDG_CACHE_HOME/pip` → Windows `%LOCALAPPDATA%/pip/Cache`

## Locations

| Path | Item | Safety | Why | Actions |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `{cache}` | pip cache | Safe | This is a download cache; it is fetched again when needed (`REDOWNLOADABLE`) | `native:pip-cache-purge`, `quarantine` |

## Native commands

- `native:pip-cache-purge` runs `pip cache purge` (timeout 300 s, freed space measured before and after)
